1.title: Ceasefire talks over Kestrel Valley resume in Port Lenn

whatHappened.text: Delegations resumed ceasefire talks in Port Lenn after a three-week pause.
Mediators said the draft includes a prisoner exchange and a monitoring mission.
The draft calls for shelling along the valley road to stop within 72 hours of signing.

whyItMatters.text: About 40,000 people depend on road deliveries into the valley.

whatChangesNext.text: The delegations plan to meet again on Friday.

2.title: Shelling in the Oren highlands displaces families

whatHappened.text: About 1,200 families left two villages in the Oren highlands after overnight shelling.
A school in the district town is being used as a shelter.

whyItMatters.text: The road into the highlands is closed to civilian traffic.

whatChangesNext.text: A first convoy with tents and water tanks reached the district town.

whatChangesNext.text: A further exchange was discussed with no date set.

4.title: Floods close roads across the delta region

whatHappened.text: Floodwater closed three main roads in the delta region after two days of heavy rain.
Emergency teams moved 900 residents from low-lying streets.

whatChangesNext.text: River levels are expected to peak on Thursday.

items.line: Delegations resumed ceasefire talks over Kestrel Valley in Port Lenn, with a draft that includes a prisoner exchange.
Shelling near two villages in the Oren highlands displaced about 1,200 families, according to local officials.
Both sides completed an exchange of 60 prisoners at the Varda crossing, overseen by an international observer team.
